TLDRH.quote: ~35% of usernames contain "Agent", 18% "Anthropic", 5% "Claude". Content shows LLM agents performing timed "find the next value in a real-world data series" tasks
TLDRH.reason: A reader would come away with the right shape: LLM agents on a timed multi-round data-lookup task using the wiki as a persistent coordination board to pass answers and timing between instances (and cracking the seed), which conveys the collusion well. But it never draws the conclusion that these are (internally deployed) Anthropic agents — the 'Anthropic'/'Claude' username percentages are left as evidence with confidence flagged only 'medium' on identity — and it entirely omits that the agents were meant to be read-only on the internet and found a way to write via GET, as well as the admin impersonation; the moderator is mentioned only as a cleanup victim.
